title: UNVERIFIED — The Couch by the Front Window

features.name: a fifty-cent paperback from Cooks Hill
features.desc-on-touch: Australian novels, almost all just skirting the war years. Somebody has been expected home for several pages. Whenever a car slows outside, he looks up on their behalf.

features.name: scissors
features.desc-on-touch: The woman he is staying with walks in a little too purposefully. A friend is coming to have her hair cut. He asks if this is something she knows how to do. A towel is already going down.

features.name: the back stoop
features.desc-on-touch: Two women inside, although it sounds like many more, laughing in rooms full of sunlight. He will return to this afternoon, as now, for stretched decades.

features.name: a letter, arriving in a novel
features.desc-on-touch: Characters were often waiting for one, and when it arrived it made a sound like radio crackle. Aged Morse, five words.

inscription: later of paperbarks, now of paperarcs
